leadText: Sign Of Victory is the opening theme for the 2013 Korean redubbing of Lucario and the Mystery of Mew. It is performed by Kim Sanguk.
plainText:
Sign Of Victory is the opening theme for the 2013 Korean redubbing of Lucario and the Mystery of Mew. It is performed by Kim Sanguk.

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 

All For You 
 
 
 

Forever
 
 
Sign of Victory

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 

All For You 
 
 
 

Forever
 
 
Sign of Victory

All For You 
 
 
 

Forever
 
 
 

 
 
 
Sign of Victory 

A new step
For a step towards victory
I'll approach closer

The hot sun
The cold wind
Even if everything blocks you
You'll win through

The strength held in my two hands
Will certainly reach you 
Don't forget that

All for you
Burning more passionately
Is my heart that beats for you
Heading towards victory once again

Forever
Burning recklessly
Is my heart that does not stop
Sign of victory

Endlessly high
Limitlessly wide
To wherever in the ends of the world
I'll run

My dream towards you
And my courage for you
If we are always together
We can achieve it

The strength held in my two hands
Will certainly reach you 
Don't forget that

All for you
Burning more passionately
Is my heart that beats for you
Heading towards victory once again

Forever
Burning recklessly
Is my heart that does not stop
Sign of victory

All for you
Burning more passionately
Is my heart that beats for you
Heading towards victory once again

Forever
Burning recklessly
Is my heart that does not stop
Heading towards victory once again

Remember
To run more energetically
For the endless victory
Sign of victory
